import cv2, numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0037.png')
# let's look at all legs of chair in obs 37
chair_mask = (img[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img[:, :, 0] < 50) & (img[:, :, 1] < 80)
# Find column slices where legs touch floor
vs, us = np.where(chair_mask)
print('Chair u in', us.min(), us.max(), 'v in', vs.min(), vs.max())
# Find bottom-most pixel for each leg:
for u in range(us.min(), us.max() + 1):
    v_leg = vs[us == u].max()
    if v_leg > 350:
        print(f'u={u}, max v={v_leg}')
